requirements.text: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
requirements.source_phrase: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk

outcomes.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.

nodes.question: Does the edited image visibly have a chalk-like drawing medium or surface treatment?
nodes.criteria: pass: visible chalk-like marks or texture establish a chalk medium; fail: the image is clearly rendered in a non-chalk medium with no visible chalk treatment; unknown: the medium cannot be determined from the image.
nodes.binding: Assess only visible evidence that the image uses a chalk-like medium or treatment.

nodes.question: Does the edited image visibly present its depicted content as a drawing rather than as an unchanged photograph?
nodes.criteria: pass: visible rendering establishes a drawing, such as drawn or illustrated forms; fail: the depicted content remains clearly photographic with no visible drawing conversion; unknown: the image does not establish whether it is a drawing or photograph.
nodes.binding: Assess only whether the image has been rendered as a drawing; do not assess its medium.

nodes.question: Has the image been transformed into a drawing made from chalk?
nodes.criteria: Use only the saved statuses and image-grounded evidence from n1 and n2. complete: both supports pass, establishing both a chalk medium and a drawing. partial: at least one support passes, but the other fails, so some requested transformation is evidenced without complete fulfillment. absent: both supports fail, establishing neither requested feature. unknown: no support passes and at least one is unknown, leaving progress unresolved. A known failure is negative evidence, not uncertainty; do not infer facts beyond the support evidence. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
nodes.binding: Target: the image. Reference: a drawing made from chalk. Combine the independent evidence for chalk medium and drawing form; do not inspect images or add requirements.

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. Return status, evidence, confidence (0 to 1 or null), and used_dependency_ids. You receive no reference label or optimizer feedback. Do not predict what the optimizer wants.
Support checks receive source and edited images. Inspect only the saved visual proposition and binding. When dependencies are supplied, use those ancestor observations as context and investigate the more specific proposition yourself; do not simply repeat the parent answer. Use pass/fail/unknown. A pass on a broad parent does not imply a nested check passes. Known negative evidence is usable; uncertain or missing evidence is unknown. Do not award requested completion credit to supporting facts.
The requested fulfillment readout receives NO images. Use ALL and ONLY saved support observations, the original instruction, rubric and saved composition criteria. Use complete/partial/absent/unknown. Mere texture or object presence must not silently establish whole-image conversion or a requested spatial relation. Known progress plus evidenced incompleteness may be partial; absence means no requested progress. Missing necessary evidence is unknown, never a fabricated failure or completion. Do not infer new visual facts.
used_dependency_ids must name every supplied dependency check_id exactly once in saved order (empty when none). Confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness.

observations.evidence: The edited image has a visibly grainy, smudged surface and soft, powdery-looking marks across the scene, consistent with a chalk-like drawing treatment.
The edited image visibly renders the giraffes and surroundings with drawn outlines and a textured, illustrative appearance rather than retaining the source photograph's photographic rendering.
Both saved supports pass: n1 identifies a chalk-like medium, and n2 identifies a drawn, illustrative rendering. Together they establish the requested chalk drawing.

findings.source_phrase: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
findings.question: Do the giraffes and the rest of the depicted scene—not just the surface texture or background—visibly read as a chalk drawing?
findings.criteria: Pass if the main subjects and scene are rendered with drawing-like marks consistent with chalk; fail if chalk-like texture is present but the depicted content remains substantially photographic or otherwise not drawn; unknown if the rendering cannot be determined.
findings.evidence: The edited image has a strong grainy, smudged treatment, but the giraffes retain detailed photographic-looking shading and texture, while the background appears more broadly blurred and stylized.
findings.rationale: The existing drawing check reports illustrative outlines, and the medium check reports chalk-like texture. A focused inspection of the main subjects and scene would test whether those cues establish the requested whole-image conversion rather than only a surface treatment.
